description.trigger: Workflows in Zoho Billing can be initiated when subscription or billing events occur, such as creating a new subscription, invoice, quote, payment success/failure, or subscription lifecycle changes like pause, resume, or cancellation.
description.integration: Zoho Billing is a cloud-based subscription billing and revenue management platform. It enables businesses to automate recurring billing, manage subscriptions, generate invoices and credit notes, record payments, and handle customer accounts efficiently.

ai_description.trigger: Workflows can be triggered by subscription lifecycle changes (new, cancel, pause, resume, upgrade, downgrade, renewal), new records (invoice, quote, credit note, item, project, retainer invoice), updates (invoice), or payment events (success, failure)..
ai_description.integration: Zoho Billing is a cloud-based subscription billing and revenue management platform. Supported actions include creating customers, subscriptions, invoices, quotes, items, retainer invoices, credit notes, plans, and addons.
